    - heading "Understand Exact Proof" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "An exact proof gives logical reasons showing a geometric statement is always true. In Exact Proof, that statement is the exact rule used on the labelled chart and in the three numerical examples. A useful rule is Proof chain: given facts -> valid steps -> conclusion. You can learn Exact Proof by trying one small example instead of long theory."
